# zerops_project (Data Source)

Looks up exactly one project by ID or exact case-sensitive name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "zerops_project" "example" {
  name = "my-project"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization id.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `env_isolation` (String) Env isolation.
- `location` (String) Location.
- `mode` (String) Mode.
- `public_ipv4` (String) Public ipv4.
- `public_ipv4_shared` (Boolean) Shared public IPv4 enabled.
- `public_ipv6` (String) Public ipv6.
- `ssh_isolation` (String) Ssh isolation.
- `status` (String) Status.
- `tags` (Set of String) Project tags.
- `zerops_subdomain_host` (String) Zerops subdomain host.
